import {
  defineApp,
  nav,
  Screen,
  Stack,
  Row,
  Card,
  Divider,
  Text,
  List,
  ListItem,
  EmptyState,
  Modal,
  TextInput,
  NumberInput,
  Stepper,
  Picker,
  DateInput,
  Button,
  toast,
  useState,
  useEffect,
  storage,
  type SchemaArtifact,
} from 'vc-sdk';

const SCHEMA: SchemaArtifact = {
  schemaVersion: 1,
  collections: {},
};

type Exercise = { id: string; name: string; weight: number; reps: number };
type Workout = { id: string; date: number; exercises: Exercise[] };

const DAY_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

const COMMON_LIFTS = [
  'Back squat',
  'Bench press',
  'Deadlift',
  'Overhead press',
  'Barbell row',
  'Romanian deadlift',
  'Lat pulldown',
  'Leg press',
  'Pull-up',
  'Bicep curl',
];

const TEMPLATE: { name: string; weight: number; reps: number }[] = [
  { name: 'Back squat', weight: 20, reps: 8 },
  { name: 'Bench press', weight: 20, reps: 8 },
  { name: 'Barbell row', weight: 20, reps: 8 },
  { name: 'Overhead press', weight: 20, reps: 8 },
  { name: 'Romanian deadlift', weight: 20, reps: 8 },
];

let seq = 0;

function uid(): string {
  seq += 1;
  return `x${Date.now().toString(36)}${seq.toString(36)}`;
}

let selected: Workout | null = null;

function todayStart(): number {
  const d = new Date();
  d.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  return d.getTime();
}

function startOfDaysAgo(days: number): number {
  const d = new Date(Date.now() - days * DAY_MS);
  d.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  return d.getTime();
}

function dayLabel(ms: number): string {
  if (ms === todayStart()) return 'Today';
  if (ms === startOfDaysAgo(1)) return 'Yesterday';
  return new Date(ms).toLocaleDateString(undefined, { weekday: 'short', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });
}

function kg(n: number): string {
  return Number.isInteger(n) ? String(n) : n.toFixed(1);
}

function volume(w: Workout): number {
  return w.exercises.reduce((sum, ex) => sum + ex.weight * ex.reps, 0);
}

function totalReps(w: Workout): number {
  return w.exercises.reduce((sum, ex) => sum + ex.reps, 0);
}

function toExercise(raw: unknown): Exercise | null {
  if (typeof raw !== 'object' || raw === null) return null;
  const r = raw as Record<string, unknown>;
  const weight = Number(r.weight);
  const reps = Number(r.reps);
  return {
    id: typeof r.id === 'string' ? r.id : uid(),
    name: typeof r.name === 'string' && r.name !== '' ? r.name : 'Exercise',
    weight: Number.isFinite(weight) ? weight : 0,
    reps: Number.isFinite(reps) ? reps : 0,
  };
}

function toWorkout(raw: unknown): Workout | null {
  if (typeof raw !== 'object' || raw === null) return null;
  const r = raw as Record<string, unknown>;
  const date = Number(r.date);
  if (!Number.isFinite(date)) return null;
  const list = Array.isArray(r.exercises) ? r.exercises : [];
  const exercises = list.map(toExercise).filter((ex): ex is Exercise => ex !== null);
  return { id: typeof r.id === 'string' ? r.id : uid(), date, exercises };
}

function sortWorkouts(list: Workout[]): Workout[] {
  return [...list].sort((a, b) => b.date - a.date);
}

async function loadWorkouts(): Promise<Workout[]> {
  const raw = await storage.kv.get('workouts');
  return sortWorkouts(Array.isArray(raw) ? raw.map(toWorkout).filter((w): w is Workout => w !== null) : []);
}

function openWorkout(workout: Workout) {
  selected = workout;
  nav.navigate('Detail');
}

// ── Log workout ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function LogWorkout() {
  const [date, setDate] = useState<number | null>(() => todayStart());
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<Exercise[]>(() => TEMPLATE.map((t) => ({ id: uid(), ...t })));
  const [last, setLast] = useState<Workout | null>(null);
  const [adding, setAdding] = useState(false);
  const [openId, setOpenId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [weight, setWeight] = useState(20);
  const [reps, setReps] = useState(8);

  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    loadWorkouts()
      .then((list) => {
        if (live) setLast(list.length > 0 ? list[0] : null);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (live) toast('Couldn’t load your saved workouts.');
      });
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, []);

  const openAdd = () => {
    setName('');
    setWeight(20);
    setReps(8);
    setAdding(true);
  };

  const addExercise = () => {
    const exercise = { id: uid(), name: name.trim(), weight, reps };
    setDraft([...draft, exercise]);
    setAdding(false);
    toast(`${exercise.name} added`);
  };

  const openEdit = (exercise: Exercise) => {
    setName(exercise.name);
    setWeight(exercise.weight);
    setReps(exercise.reps);
    setOpenId(exercise.id);
  };

  const saveEdit = () => {
    const id = openId;
    if (id === null) return;
    setDraft(draft.map((ex) => (ex.id === id ? { ...ex, name: name.trim() || ex.name, weight, reps } : ex)));
    setOpenId(null);
  };

  const removeEdited = () => {
    const id = openId;
    if (id === null) return;
    setDraft(draft.filter((ex) => ex.id !== id));
    setOpenId(null);
  };

  const repeatLast = () => {
    if (last === null) return;
    setDraft(last.exercises.map((ex) => ({ ...ex, id: uid() })));
    toast('Loaded your last session');
  };

  const save = () => {
    const at = date === null ? todayStart() : date;
    const workout: Workout = { id: uid(), date: at, exercises: draft };
    loadWorkouts()
      .then((list) => {
        const next = sortWorkouts([...list.filter((w) => w.date !== at), workout]);
        return storage.kv.set('workouts', next).then(() => next);
      })
      .then((next) => {
        setLast(next.length > 0 ? next[0] : null);
        toast(`Saved · ${draft.length} exercises on ${dayLabel(at).toLowerCase()}`);
      })
      .catch(() => toast('Couldn’t save that workout. Try again.'));
  };

  return (
    <Screen title="Log workout" action={{ icon: 'plus', label: 'Add exercise', onPress: openAdd }}>
      <Stack gap="lg">
        <DateInput label="Workout date" value={date} onChange={setDate} />
        <Stack gap="sm">
          <Row justify="between">
            <Text size="subtitle">Full body</Text>
            <Text color="text-muted">{draft.length === 1 ? '1 exercise' : `${draft.length} exercises`}</Text>
          </Row>
          {draft.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState icon="dumbbell" title="No exercises yet" hint="Tap + to add your first lift." />
          ) : (
            <List
              items={draft}
              keyBy="id"
              renderItem={(exercise) => (
                <ListItem
                  title={exercise.name}
                  subtitle={`${kg(exercise.weight)} kg × ${exercise.reps} reps`}
                  trailing={`${kg(exercise.weight * exercise.reps)} kg`}
                  icon="dumbbell"
                  onPress={() => openEdit(exercise)}
                />
              )}
            />
          )}
          <Text size="caption" color="text-muted">Tap an exercise to change its weight or reps.</Text>
        </Stack>
        <Button label="Save workout" icon="check" disabled={draft.length === 0} onPress={save} />
        {last !== null ? (
          <Button label="Repeat last workout" variant="secondary" icon="repeat" onPress={repeatLast} />
        ) : null}
        <Stack gap="xs">
          {last !== null ? (
            <Button
              label={`Last session: ${dayLabel(last.date)} · ${last.exercises.length} exercises`}
              variant="ghost"
              icon="dumbbell"
              onPress={() => openWorkout(last)}
            />
          ) : (
            <Text size="caption" color="text-muted" align="center">Your saved sessions show up here.</Text>
          )}
          <Button label="View history" variant="ghost" icon="calendar-days" onPress={() => nav.navigate('History')} />
        </Stack>
      </Stack>

      <Modal visible={adding} title="Add exercise" onClose={() => setAdding(false)}>
        <Stack gap="lg">
          <Picker
            label="Common lifts"
            options={COMMON_LIFTS}
            value={COMMON_LIFTS.includes(name) ? name : ''}
            placeholder="Pick a lift"
            onChange={setName}
          />
          <TextInput label="Exercise" value={name} placeholder="Anything else" onChange={setName} />
          <NumberInput label="Weight (kg)" value={weight} min={0} step={2.5} onChange={setWeight} />
          <Stepper label="Reps" value={reps} min={1} max={50} onChange={setReps} />
          <Button label="Add to workout" variant="secondary" icon="plus" disabled={name.trim() === ''} onPress={addExercise} />
        </Stack>
      </Modal>

      <Modal visible={openId !== null} title="Edit exercise" onClose={() => setOpenId(null)}>
        <Stack gap="lg">
          <TextInput label="Exercise" value={name} onChange={setName} />
          <NumberInput label="Weight (kg)" value={weight} min={0} step={2.5} onChange={setWeight} />
          <Stepper label="Reps" value={reps} min={1} max={50} onChange={setReps} />
          <Row>
            <Button label="Remove" variant="danger" icon="trash-2" onPress={removeEdited} />
            <Button label="Save" variant="secondary" icon="check" disabled={name.trim() === ''} onPress={saveEdit} />
          </Row>
        </Stack>
      </Modal>
    </Screen>
  );
}

// ── History ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function History() {
  const [workouts, setWorkouts] = useState<Workout[]>([]);
  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    loadWorkouts()
      .then((list) => {
        if (!live) return;
        setWorkouts(list);
        setLoaded(true);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (!live) return;
        setLoaded(true);
        toast('Couldn’t load your history.');
      });
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <Screen title="History">
      <Stack gap="lg">
        {workouts.length === 0 ? (
          loaded ? (
            <EmptyState icon="calendar-days" title="No workouts yet" hint="Save a session and it appears here by date." />
          ) : (
            <Text color="text-muted">Loading your workouts…</Text>
          )
        ) : (
          <List
            items={workouts}
            keyBy="id"
            renderItem={(workout) => (
              <ListItem
                title={dayLabel(workout.date)}
                subtitle={`${workout.exercises.length === 1 ? '1 exercise' : `${workout.exercises.length} exercises`} · ${kg(volume(workout))} kg`}
                icon="dumbbell"
                onPress={() => openWorkout(workout)}
              />
            )}
          />
        )}
      </Stack>
    </Screen>
  );
}

// ── Workout detail ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function WorkoutDetail() {
  if (selected === null) {
    return (
      <Screen title="Workout">
        <Stack>
          <Text color="text-muted">Open a date in History to see what you lifted.</Text>
        </Stack>
      </Screen>
    );
  }

  const workout = selected;

  const remove = () => {
    loadWorkouts()
      .then((list) => storage.kv.set('workouts', list.filter((w) => w.date !== workout.date)))
      .then(() => {
        toast('Workout deleted');
        nav.back();
      })
      .catch(() => toast('Couldn’t delete that workout.'));
  };

  return (
    <Screen title={dayLabel(workout.date)}>
      <Stack gap="lg">
        <Card>
          <Stack>
            <Row justify="between">
              <Text color="text-muted">Exercises</Text>
              <Text>{String(workout.exercises.length)}</Text>
            </Row>
            <Row justify="between">
              <Text color="text-muted">Total reps</Text>
              <Text>{String(totalReps(workout))}</Text>
            </Row>
            <Divider />
            <Row justify="between">
              <Text weight="semibold">Volume lifted</Text>
              <Text size="title" color="primary">{`${kg(volume(workout))} kg`}</Text>
            </Row>
          </Stack>
        </Card>

        <List
          items={workout.exercises}
          keyBy="id"
          renderItem={(exercise) => (
            <ListItem
              title={exercise.name}
              subtitle={`${kg(exercise.weight)} kg × ${exercise.reps} reps`}
              trailing={`${kg(exercise.weight * exercise.reps)} kg`}
              icon="dumbbell"
            />
          )}
        />

        <Button label="Delete workout" variant="danger" icon="trash-2" onPress={remove} />
      </Stack>
    </Screen>
  );
}

export default defineApp({
  name: 'Workout Log',
  initial: 'Log',
  screens: { Log: LogWorkout, History, Detail: WorkoutDetail },
  capabilities: ['storage'],
  schema: SCHEMA,
  tint: ['indigo', 'slate', 'violet'],
  icon: 'dumbbell',
});
